basic_profile.bio: StarGazer_77 is a 34-year-old software engineer from Portland, Oregon, who has been an active Redditor for over five years. With a strong passion for astronomy and space simulations, they spend their free time playing games like Elite Dangerous and sharing tips on enhancing in-game graphics. They are also an avid Magic: The Gathering player, often participating in and discussing MTG cube formats. Outside of gaming, they enjoy fireworks and are a regular contributor to pyrotechnics discussions. They are married and typically online during evenings and weekends, balancing their tech-centric job with their hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Knowledgeable in software development and computer graphics, StarGazer_77 has a degree in Computer Science from Oregon State University. They have honed their expertise through both professional experience as a software engineer and personal interests in gaming and visual effects.
